payload.subject: Pull qwen-general 1.1.0 compatibility and integrated vBook recovery changes

production_path.rule: Windows and vBook must use the Linux vtext relay and must not call qwen-general or raw Ollama directly

contract.success: HTTP 200, non-empty assistant content, and done=true
contract.request_id: Opaque 1-128 characters; missing, empty, or oversized values normalize to a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal UUID

refine_policies.vbook_reason: Preserve the published conservative vBook production and refine-only recovery contract from ad22455
refine_policies.atomicity: No complete refine result is returned until every bounded correction and structure call succeeds
refine_policies.empty_input: Chunked recovery now fails explicitly instead of publishing empty clean/summary output

client_changes: vBook bundle production remains forced through the Linux server relay
--refine-only --bundle vbook recovers clean and summary artifacts without rerunning ASR
Recovery preserves prior refine errors under manifest.recovery.previous_errors
Recovery never rewrites the raw transcript
English and Chinese sentence punctuation plus newlines are supported as bounded split points
Current refine defaults and manifest model metadata use qwen3.6:latest

validation.ruff: passed for changed runtime and tests
validation.production_health: Local and LAN HTTP 200, contract_version=1.1.0, qwen3.6, ASR and LLM queues empty

required_actions: Run git pull --ff-only origin main in the Windows vtext checkout
Run the client test suite and report the pulled commit and result
Confirm vBook bundle and refine-only recovery still route only through http://192.168.0.122:8000
Report any Windows-only regression with command, traceback, and affected artifact path
constraints: Do not rerun wave 009 ASR/refine or mutate its vBook attempt history without new operator approval
Do not remove the vBook-owned pause.request from vtext
Do not point Windows or vBook directly at vision.lingrengame.com:7866 or any raw Ollama port
Do not change the qwen3.6 baseline or 6000-character vBook recovery contract without coordination
